rejection_rules: Same core algorithm under another paper, method name, implementation language or wrapper
Only depth, width, heads, rank, dropout, learning rate or number of iterations changed
Same mechanism moved from residual branch to Flat input; placement alone is not a new method
Same mechanism duplicated within the proposed round
Primitive MLP, Hadamard product, scalar/feature gate used to fill the quota
Unverified novelty: hold as pending, never count as accepted or launch

core.chain: Two independent query/key maps -> two separately normalized attention maps -> learned signed subtraction -> shared doubled-width value aggregation -> per-head RMSNorm -> fixed (1-lambda_init) scaling -> output projection.
core.equation: For each differential head, A=softmax(Q1 K1^T/sqrt(d))-lambda*softmax(Q2 K2^T/sqrt(d)); Y=(1-lambda_init)*RMSNorm(A V); concatenate Y and apply Wo. lambda=exp(dot(lambda_q1,lambda_k1))-exp(dot(lambda_q2,lambda_k2))+lambda_init.

Signed subtraction before value aggregation
Learned exponential-difference lambda parameterization

core.chain: Positive Q/K features -> reciprocal source/sink capacities -> opposite-side conservation refinement -> competitive source redistribution -> normalized associative KV aggregation -> sink allocation -> output projection.
core.equation: q=sigmoid(Wq X),k=sigmoid(Wk X). i=1/dot(q+eps,sum(k)+eps), o=1/dot(k+eps,sum(q)+eps). ci=dot(q+eps,sum(k*o)+eps); co=clip(dot(k+eps,sum(q*i)+eps),-1,1). c=N*softmax(co); a=sigmoid(ci*Nq/Nk); Y=a*(q*i)@(k^T@(V*c)), followed by Wo.
must_preserve: Both source and sink capacities
Both conservation refinements
Source competition and sink allocation
Capacity-normalized aggregation
Actual active cardinality factors

methods.core: Alternating coupling splits condition positive bin widths/heights and positive knot derivatives on unchanged coordinates. Each transformed coordinate uses a monotone rational-quadratic interpolant, with analytic inverse and identity tails. Stacking alternating splits gives an invertible nonlinear multivariate transformation, not a scalar evidence gate.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: None performs an analytically invertible monotone spline coupling stack. TabNet selects coordinates, NODE routes to leaves, and CRATE compresses/sparsifies. The distinction is the constrained bijective coupling algorithm, not the insertion position or conditioner MLP.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Do not separately count RealNVP, NICE, affine coupling, Glow or other spline-flow variants in this round. DEQ uses an implicit non-bijective state solve; LRPCA decomposes low-rank plus sparse components. Other lanes require coordinator reconciliation.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: Pinned CouplingTransform splits identity/transformed features; PiecewiseRationalQuadraticCouplingTransform calls the positive-knot rational-quadratic operator and its analytic inverse.

methods.core: Threshold the matrix residual to estimate signed sparse corruption, then update two low-rank factors using their inverse Gram matrices as preconditioners. Both factors use the old factor pair for a simultaneous step. A spectral initializer precedes the finite learned iteration chain. The source also offers recurrent continuation, which is not selected here.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: NMF models a nonnegative product and has no separate signed sparse residual or inverse-Gram factor scaling. CRATE applies sparse coding/ISTA after subspace attention and does not jointly solve low-rank-plus-sparse evidence decomposition. LRPCA retains coupled sparse classification and preconditioned low-rank factor updates, not merely another matrix-factorization rank or iteration count.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Do not also count PCP/ADMM-RPCA, AltProj or another unrolled robust-PCA solver without proving a different substantive core. NSF is invertible coordinate transport; DEQ solves a general contractive state rather than low-rank/sparse factors. Other lanes require reconciliation.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: Pinned MatNet.forward computes thresholded residuals, V(V^T V)^-1 and U(U^T U)^-1 scaling, and simultaneous old-factor updates.

methods.core: A weight-tied nonlinear map is evaluated at its fixed point using a root solver without recording all forward iterations. Training solves a transpose-Jacobian linear fixed-point system for the implicit adjoint. The root-and-adjoint pair, rather than the choice of sequence backbone, is the transferred mechanism.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: First-round equilibrium_aggregation optimizes a learned scalar potential with ten explicitly differentiated Nesterov steps. This candidate permits a nonconservative nonlinear map, solves f(z)-z=0 to tolerance and differentiates the equilibrium through an implicit adjoint. It is not the same energy optimizer moved to Flat input. RRN uses a prescribed finite LSTM message-update trajectory, without root solving or an implicit adjoint. If implementation falls back to a fixed unrolled map or recycles the EA energy, reject it as failing this distinction.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Treat generic implicit-layer / DEQ variants as one candidate. A convex optimization layer differentiated by KKT may overlap strongly and needs a substantive program-level distinction before separate counting. LRPCA is finite explicit low-rank/sparse decomposition; NSF is analytic invertible coupling. Other lanes require coordinator reconciliation.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: Pinned _forward lines 320-322 solve under no_grad; lines 335-343 solve the transpose-Jacobian adjoint. This paired mechanism is absent from the first-round EA description.

methods.core: Complete MCA encoder-decoder: six question-bank SA blocks encode Q; six evidence-bank SGA blocks each self-attend V, cross-attend with Q_final as keys/values, then apply a4d ReLU FFN. Each sublayer has residual/post-LayerNorm. Scaled multihead attention uses sqrt(head_width). Both banks retain their token cardinalities; there is no learned latent bottleneck. The separate VQA AttFlat/answer pipeline is outside the claimed transferred core.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: The transferred computation operates on both real input banks with cardinality-preserving encoder/decoder state; no bottleneck, graph pooling or one-pass nonlocal summary. Risk of grouping all attention methods as one family is acknowledged; acceptance rests on complete bank-state computation, not paper name.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: DCN has no self-attention/FFN encoder-decoder: it synchronously updates two banks from shared affinities with two normalization axes, null slots and averaged full-value heads. MBT instead forces interaction through bottleneck tokens; coordinated with representation lane. BAN/MFH use bilinear contractions rather than this chain.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: MCA_ED.forward runs all enc_list layers before dec_list; SGA.forward performs MHAtt(x,x,x), MHAtt(y,y,x), FFN(x).

methods.core: Each dense symmetric layer appends learned nowhere-to-attend vectors to both banks, forms projected head affinities, and obtains the two directions by row/column normalization of the same affinity. Attend original full-width values and average across parallel attention maps, not concatenate projected values. Remove sentinel query rows, then update both original banks simultaneously by x+ReLU(W[x,attended_other]+b). Repeat the full layer with independent parameters. Dense refers to all-pair interactions, not DenseNet concatenation of all earlier layers.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Null-augmented bidirectional shared affinities, different softmax axes, head-averaged full-value reads, and synchronous concatenative residual fusion together define the new core. A pair of ordinary cross-attention blocks would not qualify.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: MCAN preserves SA/FFN encoder then guided decoder, absent here. DCN preserves simultaneous bidirectional updates and source null/parallel-average mechanism, absent there. BAN uses globally normalized joint pair maps for bilinear reduction rather than separate conditional distributions.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: DenseCoAttn.forward returns two original-value weighted sums; NormalSubLayer consumes both before mutating either input; DCNLayer owns sequential distinct sublayers.

methods.core: Four-step MAC with separate control and temporary reasoning-memory states. Each control is an attention mixture over conditioning tokens, using step-specific global-query projection plus prior control. The read first combines prior memory with knowledge elements, then scores those interactions using control, and averages knowledge values. The write linearly integrates retrieved information and prior memory. Preserve the mandatory control/read/write chain; optional write self-attention and gate are disabled, as explicitly allowed by the paper.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: The two-state control/data separation and two-stage memory-then-control retrieval are compulsory. Replacing them with a GRU/LSTM or a generic repeated attention pool would be an impermissible alias.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Ownership explicitly coordinated with root and representation lane. No overlap with MBT, TokenLearner/Fuser, GroupViT, NetVLAD or ToMe. Unlike BAN, attention maps change with temporary memory/control at every reasoning step.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: MACCell.control projects into inWords attention; read handles memory interactions then control interactions; write uses BOTH prior memory/info; zero_state resets the temporary computation.

methods.core: Three learned SPD-preserving dimensional reductions with two intermediate spectral rectifications, followed by LogEig Euclidean charting. The learned congruence hierarchy plus nonlinear eigenvalue floor is indispensable; isolated log-covariance is not SPDNet.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Learns a hierarchy of constrained channel-congruence SPD maps and eigenvalue nonlinearities. Sheaf transports node fibers through incidence maps, VB iterates probabilistic assignments, and LRPCA estimates low-rank plus sparse components of the data matrix. No shared core computation with those methods.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shares covariance input with isqrt_cov_full but not its fixed matrix-power pooling mechanism. Distinctness depends on retaining all three learned BiMaps and both ReEig stages; replacing the hierarchy by LogEig alone would be rejected as another normalization variant. No duplicate among attention/VQA/representation cards.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: spdnet_init_afew.m and vl_mybfc/vl_myrec/vl_mylog implement the complete six-stage SPD hierarchy.

core.chain: Persistent order-2 pair tensor -> two independent shared per-pair nonlinear channel maps -> channelwise matrix multiplication over a third vertex -> concatenate previous pair state -> linear channel compression -> repeat three complete blocks -> diagonal/off-diagonal summaries.
core.equation: For layer l and channel c, A=f_l(X), B=g_l(X), P[i,j,c]=sum_k A[i,k,c]*B[k,j,c], X_next[i,j,:]=W_l concat(X[i,j,:],P[i,j,:])+b_l. f_l and g_l are separate two-layer ReLU MLPs applied independently at every pair. No attention softmax, row normalization, Hadamard-only replacement or node-only collapse occurs between blocks.
core.equivariance: Under a simultaneous permutation of pair axes, each channel transforms X_c -> Q X_c Q^T, and its product transforms identically. Endpoint feature lifting and diagonal extraction respect the same relabeling when categorical role/head identities move with the tokens.
must_preserve: A learned feature vector for EVERY active ordered pair throughout all three blocks
Independent left and right nonlinear pair transforms
The sum over intermediate vertex k, with matching channels, not a dot product over features
Concatenation of old pair state before the source linear compression
ReLU after each of the two branch affine layers, but no invented activation after the skip reducer
Separate diagonal and off-diagonal summaries from every block

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: RRN aggregates endpoint-conditioned messages into node LSTM states. EGT preserves edge states but its attention and edge updates do not multiply two complete edge-state matrices through intermediate k. Sheaf learns incidence restriction maps and applies normalized diffusion to node features; PNA combines neighborhood statistics; Hyper-SAGNN contrasts static/contextual representations. None is the source PPGN pair-state product-plus-concatenation recurrence. Merely using more graph layers or a complete graph would not establish this difference.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: neural_logic_machine_evidence maintains arities0/1/2/3 with variable expansion, existential max/universal min reductions, all variable-axis permutations and shared sigmoid inference. PPGN remains order2 and composes relations by sum_k f(X_ik)g(X_kj); it has no arity lattice or quantifier operations. DAT sends relation-valued node messages, DCFormer mixes attention heads, and other attention candidates normalize pairwise node scores, rather than retaining and multiplying learned pair-state matrices. isqrt_cov_full/spdnet_bimap_reeig_logeig act on feature covariance/SPD matrices, not the vertex-pair tensor. NetVLAD encodes center-relative moments without relation-path composition.
